steps.title: Front stub and journal
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as crankshaft_4.ipt.
Sketch on the XY Plane the half section: 32 diameter for 110, then 64 diameter for 38. Revolve about the axis.

steps.title: Webs
actions: Sketch a web on the YZ Plane: a circle R70 on the main axis, a circle R36 on the pin 44 off the axis, and two lines Tangent to the R36 circle at 33 degrees to each other, closed by an arc R80 on the main axis. Extrude 15.5 mm. Make eight webs, two to each throw, the throws 114 apart.
steps.note: Section A-A on the sheet shows the web: the R80 counterweight, the 33 degree sides and the R36 (72 diameter) pin end.

steps.title: Crank pins
actions: Sketch a 64 circle 44 off the axis between each pair of webs. Extrude 45 mm. Throws 1 and 4 down, 2 and 3 up (180 degrees apart).

steps.title: Main journals
actions: Sketch a 64 circle on the main axis between each pair of throws. Extrude 38 mm. The rear journal runs to the flange.

steps.title: Flange
actions: Sketch a 144 circle on the end of the rear journal. Extrude 15 mm (619 overall).

steps.title: Flange holes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Hole 10 diameter on the 109 pitch circle, Through. Circular Pattern: 6.
steps.note: The flywheel bolts to these holes.

steps.title: Chamfers
actions: Chamfer: 2 mm on the flange edge, 1 mm on the front end.
